consultation.title: Initial Consultation
consultation.desc: Our journey begins when you reach out with your health concerns or medical reports. We meticulously analyze your requirements to recommend the most appropriate treatment plan, complete with transparent pricing and duration estimates.

travel.title: Travel Arrangements
travel.desc: Once you approve the treatment plan, we handle all travel logistics including visa assistance, flight booking, medical clearances, and airport transfers with premium vehicles.

medical.title: Hospital & Treatment
medical.desc: Upon arrival, you are received by our personal concierge. We coordinate with the hospital for seamless admission, ensure your medical team is briefed, and stay by your side throughout the treatment.

recovery.title: Luxury Recovery
recovery.desc: Post-treatment, we arrange your stay at a 5-star recovery hotel. Our team manages follow-up appointments, medication schedules, dietary requirements, and leisure activities for companions.

support.title: Follow-Up & Support
support.desc: Before departure, we ensure all medical documents are prepared. Our support continues after you return home with telemedicine follow-ups and assistance with any post-treatment needs.

homecoming.title: Safe Return Home
homecoming.desc: We coordinate your departure logistics, ensure all medical records and prescriptions are organized, and arrange comfortable travel back home. Our relationship continues with ongoing support.
